sex.evidence: A total of 85 Wistar rats (43 males and 42 females) were obtained

dosing.doses_raw: 0.5X, 1X and 2X the ritualistic dose; 1X = 0.26 mg/kg bw DMT, 2.58 mg/kg bw harmine, 0.171 mg/kg bw harmaline and 0.33 mg/kg bw tetrahydroharmine
dosing.evidence: Animals were treated daily in the morning by gavage for 28 days... doses of 0.5X (Aya0.5), 1X (Aya1) and 2X (Aya2) the dose used in a religious ritual

group_housing.evidence: each box accommodating only one animal

day_night_flipped.evidence: light/dark cycle of 12 h/12 h (direction not specified)

assays.assay_description: 5-min test in open field arena; measures locomotion (quadrants covered), entries in central quadrant, % central entries, rearing, grooming, urination and defecation.

application_type.evidence: Animals were treated daily in the morning by gavage for 28 days

setup_restrain.evidence: the animal was placed individually in the central quadrant of the open field (OF) arena and observed for 5 min

food_restriction.evidence: received commercial rodent feed and filtered water ad libitum; tests conducted in OF arena

water_restriction.evidence: received commercial rodent feed and filtered water ad libitum; tests conducted in OF arena

time_to_assay.evidence: The behavior tests were conducted one hour after the last treatment

sample_size.evidence: Control: n = 8 females and 8 males, FLX: n = 9 females and 9 males, Aya0.5: n = 9 females and 7 males, Aya1: n = 8 females and 10 males, Aya2: n = 8 females and 9 males

outcomes.summary: Locomotion was unaffected by ayahuasca or fluoxetine. Male Aya1 rats explored the central quadrant less and had a lower % of central entries than controls; fluoxetine males showed a similar anxiogenic-like decrease in % central entries. Other OF parameters were unchanged.
outcomes.statistics: p < 0.05 (Aya1 males and FLX vs control)
outcomes.evidence: Male rats from the Aya1 group explored the central quadrant less than control animals, and the ratio between the number of entries in the central area and number of quadrants covered (% of central entries) was significantly lower in male rats of Aya1 and FLX groups

B1_num_measures.evidence: locomotion (quadrants covered), entries in central quadrant, % central entries, rearing, grooming, urination and defecation

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: observed for 5 min for locomotion and number of entries (total counts)

B3_sequential_structure.evidence: No transitional or sequential analysis described

B4_ethological.evidence: rearing, grooming, urination and defecation were also evaluated

B5_social.evidence: animal was placed individually; OF is not a social assay

B6_cognitive.evidence: OF assesses innate exploration/anxiety, not learning

B7_automated_classification.evidence: No automated behavioural classification software described

E2_shelter.evidence: Open field has no enclosed refuge

E8_food_water.evidence: No food/water in the arena during the 5-min test

D3_recording_days.evidence: Behavior tests were conducted one hour after the last treatment

D5_followup.evidence: Animals euthanized 3 h after last treatment; no >=24 h follow-up

assays.assay_description: 5-min test in EPM; measures entries in open and closed arms, time spent in each arm, plus rearing, grooming, urination and defecation.

application_type.evidence: treated daily by gavage for 28 days

setup_restrain.evidence: the animal was placed in the central open cross area of the elevated-plus-maze (EPM) apparatus and evaluated for 5 min

food_restriction.evidence: food/water ad libitum in home cage; not in EPM apparatus

water_restriction.evidence: food/water ad libitum in home cage; not in EPM apparatus

time_to_assay.evidence: The behavior tests were conducted one hour after the last treatment

sample_size.evidence: Control: n = 8 females and 8 males, FLX: n = 9 females and 9 males, Aya0.5: n = 9 females and 7 males, Aya1: n = 8 females and 10 males, Aya2: n = 8 females and 9 males

outcomes.summary: Ayahuasca (all doses) and fluoxetine did not significantly alter any measured EPM parameters (entries or time in open/closed arms, rearing, grooming, urination, defecation).
outcomes.evidence: Treatment with ayahuasca (and fluoxetine) did not affect... all parameters evaluated in the EPM (data not shown).

B1_num_measures.evidence: entries in closed and open arms, time spent in each arm, rearing, grooming, urination and defecation

B4_ethological.evidence: rearing, grooming, urination and defecation were also evaluated

B5_social.evidence: Animal tested alone; EPM is not a social assay

B6_cognitive.evidence: EPM assesses innate anxiety, not learning

E2_shelter.evidence: EPM closed arms are part of apparatus design, not a shelter (per rubric)

E6_spatial.evidence: EPM arms are open-ended extensions of central platform (per rubric)

E8_food_water.evidence: No food/water in EPM during 5-min test

D3_recording_days.evidence: Behavior tests were conducted one hour after the last treatment

D5_followup.evidence: Animals euthanized 3 h after last treatment

judge_notes: Two assays retained: Open Field Test and Elevated Plus Maze. All candidates agreed on these.

B1 scored 3 (7+ measures): OFT reports quadrants covered, central entries, % central entries, rearing, grooming, urination, defecation; EPM reports open/closed/central arm entries, time in each, rearing, grooming, urination, defecation. Sided with qwen/gptoss over glm's 4-6.
B5 scored 0 (None) — overrode gptoss's 'Social construct' since OFT/EPM are not social assays per rubric (B5=0 examples).
day_night_flipped set to not_reported (medium confidence) — paper states 12:12 cycle but not direction.
Excluded ex-vivo HPLC monoamine analysis, BDNF ELISA, hematology and biochemistry — not behavioural assays.
n_per_group_min set to 7 (Aya0.5 males, smallest cell).
